application.name: Surgical De-identification (In-Body / Out-of-Body Classifier)
application.description: Binary in-body / out-of-body surgical-video classifier used as a de-identification pre-filter. Pipeline: VideoFileReaderOp (FFmpeg decode) -> TensorPreprocessorOp (NPP resize + normalize) -> InferenceOp (TensorRT de_id.onnx) -> ClassificationPrinterOp (stdout).

changelog.1.0.0: Port from Holohub surgical_deidentification app to holoscan-applications.

data.name: Endoscopy out-of-body detection sample
data.description: ONNX model and sample MP4 used by the stock config.yaml.

classify.description: Run the full classifier pipeline against the NGC endoscopy_out_of_body_detection dataset. The stock config.yaml resolves model and video paths under /data/endoscopy_out_of_body_detection/; the user must explicitly mount the dataset directory at /data (for example: holoscan run surgical_deidentification --docker-opts="-v <repository>/data:/data"). The dataset is fetched by the CMake download target during build when SURGICAL_DEID_DOWNLOAD_DATA=ON.

ci.description: Finite, headless, non-interactive self-test with no external dataset. Loads the Holoscan dynamic libraries and exits 0 — exercises the build and dependency surface without requiring the NGC data mount or GPU access.
